text: also camera dragging is cooked. if u spin around in a 360 it chokes bad
resolution: Spinning the iso view 360 with drag-rotate choked. A drag-rotate issues a redraw per mouse-move, and the static scene content (WorldStatics terrain/landforms/props plus the texture-capture mounts) was rendered inline with no memoization, so every redraw re-ran and re-reconciled the entire world tree dozens of times a second. Hoisted that static content into useMemo keyed on the world/skin inputs so a camera-only redraw skips it entirely — only the camera, grid, pieces, and ghost stay live. PlacedPieceMeshes was already memoized with stable props, so the un-memoized world statics were the remaining per-tick cost. Committed 8d9643b03, bundles clean.
